name: cg_coin_price
description:
Current price, 24-hour change and market cap for one or more cryptocurrencies, from CoinGecko (simple/price).
Returns {coin_id: {<vs>: price, <vs>_market_cap, <vs>_24h_change (percent)}} per requested coin.
Inputs (* required): ids* (string, comma-separated CoinGecko coin ids such as bitcoin,ethereum,solana; not ticker symbols), vs (string, quote currency such as usd, eur, btc; default usd; several can be comma-separated).
For ranked lists with volume use cg_coin_markets; for history cg_coin_market_chart or cg_coin_history.
Example: {"ids": "bitcoin,ethereum", "vs": "usd"}

vs.description: Quote currency code(s), comma-separated (e.g. usd or usd,eur)
